Subject: Re: Order Form term & auto-renew — proposed adjustments

Diego / team —

Quick legal POV after a brief review: we can accept a 30-day notice for auto-renew provided two conditions are met — (1) the notice calculation includes bank holidays and follows the same "calendar days" definition in the MSA to avoid ambiguity, and (2) the order form includes an explicit receipt confirmation mechanic (email to contract@redwood.com) so there is an auditable acceptance record.

On the termination-for-convenience cap: Redwood’s standard is to tie transition assistance to a percentage of the remaining committed fees rather than a flat cap. However, for enterprise pilots or deals under $500k TCV, we’ve negotiated fixed caps successfully. To move quickly, I propose this compromise: a $25k cap for the first 12 months post-signature OR 20% of remaining committed fees, whichever is lower. This gives Nimbus the predictability they want while protecting Redwood on larger commitments.

I’ve attached a short term summary spreadsheet (Redwood_Term_Summary.xlsx) that maps these options to TCV bands and recommended fallback language. If Nimbus accepts the blended approach we can mark the Order Form accordingly and push to DocuSign.

If the external team wants to discuss, I can join the Tues 10am PT sync as well.

—Karthik
Associate General Counsel
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_Term_Summary.xlsx (XLSX, 1 sheet: proposal table)

Thanks Karthik — that compromise looks reasonable. Nimbus is willing to accept the blended approach ("$25k cap for first 12 months OR 20% of remaining fees, whichever is lower") provided Redwood will: (1) add the calendar-day definition and (2) include the email receipt mechanic for notice.

Victor and I reviewed the Redwood_Term_Summary and we’ll route the updated redline to our GC for a fast review. We expect to be ready to sign within 48 hrs of receiving the updated Order Form with the agreed language.

Next steps: Diego — can you confirm who will produce the redline to reflect Karthik’s language? If possible, please send by EOD Mon 7/5 so Nimbus can hit their internal signoff window.
